front.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, its most powerful model yet
front.tldr: Google is marketing the new model as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity work, its latest move in the AI race.

front.title: Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger clears last hurdle as judge approves settlement
front.tldr: A federal judge approved the antitrust settlement clearing Paramount's merger with Warner Bros. Discovery, now expected to close as early as 6 October.

front.title: Report: Apple may hold its next hardware event on 13 October
front.tldr: Daring Fireball's John Gruber floated 13 October as the date Apple may hand iPhone Duo review units to press, and other reports now back it up. It is a report, not a confirmed date.

stories.title: AI voice startup ElevenLabs doubles valuation to $22bn
stories.tldr: A $300 million employee tender, co-led by Wellington and T. Rowe Price, values the voice AI company at $22bn, twice its previous mark.

stories.title: Valor, Atreides and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750m valuation
stories.tldr: The startup brings AI agents to hardware design and has added Sequoia's Roelof Botha as an angel investor and board member.

stories.title: Google DeepMind unveils SynthID Bio to watermark AI-generated proteins
stories.tldr: DeepMind's proof of concept watermarks AI-generated proteins while preserving their biological function, aimed at tracking synthetic biology safely.

stories.title: DoorDash launches an AI agent you can text to order food
stories.tldr: The agent lets US customers order food by text message, as DoorDash looks to gain an edge over Uber Eats and Grubhub.

stories.title: OpenAI partners with America's SBDC to help small businesses use AI
stories.tldr: The partnership expands hands-on AI training and local support for small business owners, alongside a new report on how small teams use the technology.

stories.title: BMW builds the same 3 Series for petrol and electric, with the EV $4,400 cheaper
stories.tldr: The new BMW 3 Series shows how quickly EV prices have caught up with, and now undercut, the petrol version.

stories.title: FedEx orders 2,000 electric trucks from Harbinger in $300m deal
stories.tldr: It is Harbinger's biggest order yet, as the electric truck startup reportedly considers an IPO.

stories.title: Fujifilm's Instax Pal 2 plugs into your phone to transfer images
stories.tldr: The small digital camera pairs software filters with tactile controls, making it easy to pull images onto a phone.

stories.title: Breville's new $600 coffee machine makes pour-overs from scratch
stories.tldr: The machine automates the pour-over process start to finish, though you still need to buy your own beans.

stories.title: DoorDash's drone delivery strategy started on the ground
stories.tldr: DoorDash unveiled the six-propeller aircraft for its new drone delivery business at its annual Dash Forward event.

stories.title: Apple's smart home hub will have an iMac G4-style design, report says
stories.tldr: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports the hub will feature a square six-inch display and a design echoing the old iMac G4, as part of Apple's smart home push.

stories.title: iPad Mini 8 to offer 10 new features, leak suggests
stories.tldr: The next iPad mini is expected to bring Apple's A20 Pro chip, a landscape front camera and a redesigned speaker system, among other changes.

stories.title: Here's when to expect new M6 Macs
stories.tldr: Apple's M6 chip debuted last week in the Mac mini, and more M6 upgrades, including an M6 iPad Pro, are expected to follow on a rolling schedule.

stories.title: Apple still plans to release a new full-sized HomePod
stories.tldr: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says Apple remains committed to eventually updating its larger HomePod, though no timeline was given.

stories.title: David Fincher ending Netflix deal after six years and three movies, including Cliff Booth
stories.tldr: The director of Fight Club, The Social Network and Gone Girl is not renewing his pact at Netflix when it expires next year.

stories.title: Neon plans a competing, open-source SCP Foundation anthology film
stories.tldr: Neon's anthology, built from the community-driven horror forum, will let emerging filmmakers contribute and release under a Creative Commons licence, countering A24's own SCP Foundation project.

stories.title: Ben Affleck says he used AI 'for lots of things' in new Netflix movie Animals
stories.tldr: The actor-director did not specify how AI was used in the film.

stories.title: Halsey on her new Hollywood chapter producing Our Hero, Balthazar
stories.tldr: A decade after becoming a Grammy-nominated musician, Halsey talks about moving behind the camera with one of the year's more provocative independent films.

stories.title: Celtics notice Jayson Tatum's leadership leap as camp begins
stories.tldr: Tatum organised workouts in Los Angeles last month that many teammates attended, getting a head start on chemistry with a new-look roster.

stories.title: Payton Pritchard and Mike Conley are forming a close bond at Celtics camp
stories.tldr: The pair dribble up the court together at the start of practice, with Conley guiding Pritchard toward the basket as camp gets under way.

stories.title: Wayne Barton on the 'lost tapes' behind his new Alex Ferguson book
stories.tldr: The author discusses previously unheard recordings that inspired his new book about Sir Alex Ferguson's time at Manchester United.

stories.title: Patriots vs. Bills preview for NFL Week 4
stories.tldr: New England, 1-2 after a 35-6 defeat to Jacksonville, face a pivotal divisional game against an unbeaten Buffalo side.

stories.title: Christian Gonzalez misses practice through injury; Drake Maye also lands on report
stories.tldr: Both Christian Gonzalez and Christian Barmore sat out Wednesday's session in Foxborough as New England prepares to face an unbeaten Buffalo team.

stories.title: Ocon to leave Haas, putting F1 future in doubt
stories.tldr: Esteban Ocon is fighting to save his Formula 1 career after Haas announced the split, effective at the end of the season.

stories.title: Honda secretly introduced its second F1 upgrade in Madrid
stories.tldr: Honda Racing Corporation's Koji Watanabe revealed the second ADUO upgrade was actually introduced as early as the Spanish Grand Prix.

stories.title: Mercedes braced for tougher strategy calls as Russell closes on Antonelli
stories.tldr: George Russell cut Kimi Antonelli's championship lead from 81 points to 66 at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, prompting Mercedes boss Toto Wolff to acknowledge tougher strategy calls ahead.

stories.title: Red Sox fall flat in season-ending loss to Yankees
stories.tldr: New York outscored Boston 18-2 across the Wild Card series, sweeping the Red Sox out of the playoffs for the second year running.

finally.title: Craig Mod built a mini-site cataloguing all his long walks since 2009
finally.tldr: The site maps years of long walks with GPS tracks and links to the essays and books that resulted from them.
